name: Kurutta Kajitsu
source:
Tetsu Kano, a student at Teito Private University of Fine Arts, attends a seminar party hosted by his mentor, Professor Tsukishima. From that point on, a series of bizarre events begin to unfold around him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.beep-shop.com/extragames/bisyoujyo/kajitu]BEEP[/url]]
